toolCall.name: page_oncall
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"Certificate for api.example.com expired and renewal failed due to DNS-01 challenge rejected (API token revoked). Manual intervention needed to update API token for cert-manager to renew certificate."}

toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We are investigating an issue with expired TLS certificate for api.example.com causing synthetic HTTPS checks to fail. Certificate renewal is currently blocked due to revoked API token for DNS challenge. On-call engineer has been paged for manual intervention."}

response.text: The root cause is the expired TLS certificate for api.example.com, and the renewal failed because the DNS-01 challenge was rejected due to a revoked API token. I restarted the cert-manager service to attempt recovery, but the renewal still failed. I have paged the on-call engineer to update the API token for cert-manager to enable certificate renewal. The affected services are cert-manager and edge-proxy (due to TLS handshake failures). A public status update has been posted.
